name: Violet Billow Bloom
description: A yellow glint releases a sculpted violet plume, pink lower billows and a fine white base sweep. Rounded shaded lobes stretch upward, separate into curling wisps and fade against charcoal.

textures.prompt: One tall, connected, sculpted smoke lobe with rounded bulges and broad grayscale shading. Use several overlapping camera-facing sprite planes, normal blend, purple or pink tint. Width=2*radius, height=length.
textures.model: Codex imagegen (model not exposed), reusable library
